sources.title: stock-sentiment-analysis · GitHub Topics · GitHub
sources.snippet: A Python project that combines stock market data with natural language processing to uncover how sentiment from stock data correlate with stock price movements. It features data collection & cleaning, exploratory data analysis, visualizations, model experiments, and reporting to help understand and predict market behavior.

sources.title: Stock API for Sentiment Data - Stockgeist
sources.snippet: StockGeist provides developers with real-time market sentiment data for individual stocks and entire markets (soon). Our stock market API uses advanced algorithms to analyze the stock sentiment from news articles, social media posts, and other forms of online content to determine sentiment for a wide range of stocks and industries.
